svg.aria-label: A cascade and a router in a seeded simulation
svg.text: A cascade and a router in a seeded simulation
20,000 requests; cheap call 1, large call 15, router call 0.1 (relative units, not prices)
Cascade: ask the cheap model first
oracle (large only when small is wrong):
its confidence score is built to carry information
about whether the small answer was right: 0.961 at 5.33
against the large model alone at 0.945 and 15.00
log probabilities, a verifier or agreement between samples
are noisier: measure escalation rate, accuracy and cost
on labelled traffic before trusting the saving
